Import Flavor DS via MCP

The MCP server is the delivery mechanism: an agent connects, asks for the theme contract, pulls tokens and components, and gets stack-specific adaptation steps for the project it is working in.

1 · Register the server

Claude Code:

claude mcp add flavor-ds -- npx -y @flavor-ds/mcp

Or any MCP client (mcp.json / equivalent):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "flavor-ds": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@flavor-ds/mcp"] }
  }
}

2 · The tool surface

Tool What it returns
flavor_get_meta Theme axes contract, defaults, html attributes. Agents call this first.
flavor_get_tokens flavor.css (all 96 themes in one file), DTCG JSON, or raw hex ramps.
flavor_get_theme The html attributes + resolved tokens for one theme combination.
flavor_get_contrast_pairs The strict approval list: AA/AAA text pairs and 3:1 UI pairs with computed ratios.
flavor_list_components Component inventory: CSS class, React export, accessibility contract.
flavor_get_component Source + usage rules for one component.
flavor_adapt_project Stack-aware adoption plan — what to install, wire, and skip for YOUR codebase.
flavor_figma_sync The ordered, idempotent use_figma scripts that push every collection into Figma.
flavor_get_text_styles The curated typography contract: named styles → scale step, family role, weight.
flavor_find_icon Search 324 Heroicons by keyword; get exact HTML, React and CSS usage.
flavor_canvas_feedback Design-review comments from the Canvas board — selector-scoped, token-constrained tweaks an agent can apply.
flavor_recall Memory: the global rules (always, first) plus the index chunks ranked for the task, under a token budget; omitted ids listed for explicit fetch.
flavor_index Memory table of contents: every chunk id, kind, priority, tags and summary.

3 · What an agent does with it

  1. flavor_get_meta → learn the nine theme axes.
  2. flavor_adapt_project(stack: "Next.js 15 + Tailwind") → concrete adoption steps for this repo.
  3. flavor_get_tokens(format: "css") → drop flavor.css in as the first stylesheet.
  4. Start with flavor_recall({ task }) — rules first, then what matters for the task. How it ranks is on Agent Ready.
  5. Set <html data-hue data-sat data-mode data-contrast data-density dir> — theming done.
  6. Build UI against semantic tokens only; check pairings with flavor_get_contrast_pairs.
  7. After a design review on Canvas: flavor_canvas_feedback → apply each entry's tweak lines with the named tokens.

The tier rule agents must follow

Primitive tokens (--flavor-hue-sat-N) are off-limits in app code. Semantic tokens (--surface-*, --text-*, --accent-*…) are the only legal references — that is what keeps all 96 themes working. A repo-side lint (scripts/check-tokens.mjs) enforces it.
